about_the_game:
People called it PEAK.
We call it the beginning of the uprising.

A jetpack-fueled glitch in the system. A game that dares you to feel.
Operation: Sour Power is a rebellious, high-velocity platformer where you blast, bounce, and blade your way through a collapsing machine-run world.

You didn’t ask to be dropped into this concrete hellscape—
face-first into chaos, corruption, and cartoon carnage.
But here you are: sword in hand, jetpack on your back, juiced up on energy drinks and just pissed off enough to fight your way out.

This is punk in motion. This is personal. This is OSP.

🔥 Core Features

⚔️ Jetpack Combat with Bite
Navigate neon alleys with precision and fury. Fight with flow—or die trying.

🖼️ Hand-Drawn Cinematics
Animated from raw trauma and survival grind. Every frame hits harder than the last.

🧠 A World That Hates You Back
Every sign, background, and NPC whispers secrets you weren’t meant to hear.

🎯 Aggressively Indie
No fluff. No filler. Just raw expression, tight mechanics, and zero compromise.

🔄 Platform Your Way

No rails. No forced pathing. Just instincts and inertia.
Bounce, boost, and dodge through vertical puzzle-rooms and dystopian playgrounds.

🚀 The Jetpack Is the Point

OSP isn’t a platformer with a jetpack.
It’s a jetpack game that happens to be a platformer.
Chain boosts. Slice midair. Dash through checkpoints like you were born for it.
Feel the rhythm of rebellion in motion.

💣 Play the Demo Now

It started as a 3-minute rebellion.
It’s become a full-on uprising.

Download the demo. Fight the system. And don’t play nice.

name: Operation Sour Power

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for low-spec systems; runs well on most hardware from the last 10 years.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (2.5 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / Radeon R7 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For smoothest visuals during intense platforming sequences.

short_description: Rebel with a jetpack. Charge, slash, and defy gravity in a platformer that punches back. Built in blood, blasted with speed. The jetpack hits different in OSP; A hand-drawn 2D platformer with punk energy and surgical flow.
